h1: East Facing House Plan: AutoCAD Drawings and General Vastu Notes
intro: An east-facing house has its main entrance towards the east, usually towards the rising sun. In commonly cited Vastu guidance, an east or north-east entrance is often treated as a favourable position, the north-east (Ishan) of the plot is kept relatively open and lighter, and the kitchen is often placed in the south-east, the direction associated with Agni (fire).

Other well-known points for an east-facing layout include: a master bedroom towards the south-west; a puja space in the north-east if one is required; toilets kept away from the north-east; and the centre of the house (Brahmasthan) left as clear as the plan allows, without a heavy staircase or store in the middle.

These points are general, commonly cited Vastu guidelines, not a site-specific study and not a promise of any result. If you want them considered, send your plot facing and the notes you want followed. We can take those notes into account while drafting.
